name: OpenWork
summary: Open-source desktop AI agent app — a GUI for OpenCode — for working on local files with any LLM.
description: OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) and an alternative to Claude Cowork, built as a GUI for OpenCode. Bring your own model and provider keys (50+ providers or local models), wire in skills, plugins and MCP servers, and share reusable agent setups org-wide, with an AI Gateway and MCP Gateway for teams.
contains: free MIT-licensed desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
50+ model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and local models with your own keys
Team $10/seat/month; Enterprise $40/user/month with SSO/SAML and SCIM
MCP Gateway usable from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and Gemini CLI
share skills, plugins and MCP servers org-wide via one link
self-host the platform with Helm or Docker Compose
AI Gateway with spend limits and usage analytics
OpenWork Web in the browser; Slack integration
